interpretation.go: The fine ModelConcept NCDM improves over the validation-selected non-personalized baseline with paired-bootstrap support, clears all pre-registered diagnosis sanity checks, and may authorize a separately controlled graph-model stage.
interpretation.conditional: Prediction improves but a declared non-terminal diagnosis-readiness issue requires an additional authorized diagnostic review; it never authorizes production integration.
interpretation.no_go: The fine ModelConcept NCDM does not clear every Concept Gate condition. Stop without stacking graph models.
